Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Skua Squad]] took part in a botched '''mission''' early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Due to the [[Squad/Legends|squad's]] lack of discipline, the mission resulted in the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of all of the squad's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] except for [[Ganch]], who developed a hardened attitude because of the mission.<ref name="Sideshow Ganch" />

==Behind the scenes==
Skua Squad's botched mission was mentioned as part of a [[2012]] action figure made by [[Sideshow Collectibles]] for their ''[[Militaries of Star Wars]]'' line of [[Sideshow Collectibles|''Sixth Scale Figures'']], created exclusively for the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Celebration VI]] fan convention.<ref name="Sideshow Ganch" />
